question: Does Shidian book NGJ8921188204889 provide a new independent Huqianjing physical witness, or is it another digital route to the already-counted Tianyige Ming-print scan?

shidian_route.acquisition: public page -> byted_psdk.getPtokenStatus -> pages/v3 -> byted_psdk.decrypt -> source-bound WebP

prior_counted_witness.physical_identity: 天一閣藏明刻本《虎鈐經》卷七《傳箭》第七十六
prior_counted_witness.digital_route: Tianyige Museum scan via Wikimedia Commons PDF

image_identity_test.method: No OCR. Direct visual comparison plus SIFT feature matching and RANSAC homography between individual Shidian leaves and corresponding left/right halves of the previously archived Tianyige spread images.
image_identity_test.extended_sequence_mapping: Shidian 137..158 maps in order to Tianyige spread halves 69R,69L,70R,70L,71R,71L,72R,72L,73R,73L,74R,74L,75R,75L,76R,76L,77R,77L,78R,78L,79R,79L.
visual_controls: black scan borders and gutter geometry align
paper damage, ink defects and stains align at the same positions
Shidian page 147 carries the same 傳箭第七十六 opening leaf as Tianyige PDF page 74 right half
Shidian pages 151-152 correspond to the Tianyige summer-solstice region around PDF page 76

dedup_adjudication.reason: The same continuous leaf images, including identical physical defects, are present in both routes. Platform independence is not physical-witness independence.

mechanical_control.existing_huqian_rule_family_unchanged: 20-number-arrow cycle reused across opposite half-year directions; 100-ke day; 60-fen per ke; 40/60 <-> 60/40 one-ke ladder.

transmission_impact: NONE; this batch changes digital-surrogate/access-route provenance and deduplication only. The already-counted Tianyige physical-copy node and Huqian rule-family lineage edges remain unchanged.
next_gate: Do not count Shidian and Wikimedia/Tianyige as two independent Huqian physical witnesses.
Return Sanming ancestry research to direct Datong Tonggui/Ritonggui morning-evening numerical cells and securely pre-1578 Nanjing/Datong witnesses.
Require any future 59/41 ancestry candidate to reproduce the 1578 Sanming intermediate/change-day fingerprint, not merely the extrema.
